card.name: Verbs of keeping or controlling
card.fires_on: Verbs about holding, controlling, restraining or maintaining something, such as keep, control, controls, remain, reserved, inhibit, keeping. They usually come right before the thing being kept or controlled.

modes.label: Keep or maintain
